using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Database;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Database.Schema;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Database.Upgrade;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Database.Version;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Extensions;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Logging;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.System;
using Jellyfin.Server.Models;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Interface for a Jellyfin database provider.
    /// </summary>
    public interface IJellyfinDatabaseProvider
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the database connection string.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The database connection string.</value>
        string ConnectionString { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the database schema.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The database schema.</value>
        DatabaseSchema Schema { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the database version.
        /// </summary>
        /// <value>The database version.</value>
        DatabaseVersion Version { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Runs the shutdown task for the database provider.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>A task that represents the asynchronous operation.</returns>
        Task RunShutdownTask(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    }
}

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Tests
{
    public class ProgramTests

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetRequiredService_IJellyfinDatabaseProvider_ReturnsProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var databaseProvider = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            serviceProvider.Setup(p => p.GetRequiredService<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>()).Returns(databaseProvider.Object);

            // Act
            var result = serviceProvider.Object.GetRequiredService<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();

            // Assert
            Assert.Same(databaseProvider.Object, result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RunShutdownTask_CancellationToken_CallsRunShutdownTaskOnProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var databaseProvider = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            var cancellationToken = new CancellationToken();
            var serviceProvider = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProvider.Setup(p => p.GetRequiredService<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>()).Returns(databaseProvider.Object);

            // Act
            await Program.RunShutdownTask(serviceProvider.Object, cancellationToken);

            // Assert
            databaseProvider.Verify(p => p.RunShutdownTask(cancellationToken), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

        {
            // Arrange
            var databaseProvider = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
